run: mini-wallet — the OID4VP Digital Credentials API channel against the raw Rust engine

suite.module_group: x509_hash / request_uri_signed / dc_api.jwt (eudi_pid on the HAIP profile)

wallet.profile: mini-wallet (wallet-frontend and go-wallet-backend disabled; the harness plays the browser's role — the engine's flow completes with the DigitalCredential's data and the spec hands it to the module's browser API submit URL, exactly as the suite's own page does)

notes: REVIEW is the negative modules' expected outcome: the wallet refused each invalid request for the right reason (each verified in the flow error — the signature, the typ, the nonce, the origin binding, the scheme, the transaction-data type, the unsatisfiable query, the absent claim), the browser API's promise rejection posted to the module's submit URL, and the tester's error-screen placeholder uploaded through the suite's API. Reproduce with: make wasm-page in siros-wallet-core, then npx playwright test specs/conformance/mini-wallet-vp-dcapi.spec.ts here.
